title: tvkit per-TV record (<tv-id>.json)
description: Sanitized. Never holds a pairing code, cookie, key, password or adb key. An OFFSITE record never mentions a home network address, any private address, a .local/.lan name or a machine name listed in kit.json lan_hostnames, and never stores adb_target or ha. tvkit check enforces these.

tv_id.description: A new UUID v4 minted by `tvkit new`. Never reused: a revoked or re-added TV gets a new one and the old record stays with status revoked.

name.description: A label for the TV, e.g. Living Room TV

model.description: From the baseline: manufacturer, model, Android version

apps.description: Package names on the Free My TV shelf (for the record only; the owner edits the shelf on the TV)

city.description: The weather city the owner set in Home Settings -> City (name only)

tz.description: The TV's time zone, e.g. Europe/London

adb_target.description: HOME only: where adb reaches the TV (host:port). It is a route, not an identity. Never for OFFSITE.

ha.description: HOME only, optional: Home Assistant entity ids once the TV joins Home Assistant (Android TV Remote integration)

requests_url.description: The https page this TV is pointed at (open-requests, offsite sheet, USB pack). No built-in default.
